name: Power input header
description: A two-pin power input header with a bulk capacitor across the rails.

parameters.description: Reference designator for the bulk capacitor.

notes: The header uses the built-in pinrow2 footprint so it resolves without network access; its supplier footprint may differ.
No reverse-polarity or overcurrent protection is included.
